# Wisdom of Solomon Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Wisdom 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/WIS_008_page_001.jpg

---

**8:1** She reaches from end to end mightily, and she-orders all-things well.

**8:2** Her I-loved and I-sought from my youth, and I-sought to-take her as bride for myself, and I-became a-lover of her beauty.

**8:3** She glorifies her noble-birth by having-companionship with God, and the Master of all things loved her.

**8:4** For she is an initiate of the knowledge of God, and a chooser of his works.

**8:5** But if riches is a desired possession in life, what is richer than Wisdom, the [one] working all-things?

**8:6** But if understanding works, who more than she among all-things is a craftsman?

**8:7** And if one loves righteousness, the labors of her are virtues; for she teaches temperance and prudence, justice and courage, and there is nothing more useful than these in life to men.

**8:8** But if one longs also for much experience, she knows the things of old and the things about to [come], she understands the subtleties of words and the solutions of riddles, signs and wonders she knows beforehand and the outcomes of seasons and times.

**8:9** I decided therefore to take her to live-with [me], knowing that she will be a counselor of good-things and a comfort in cares and grief.

**8:10** Because-of her I shall have glory among crowds, and honor in-the-presence-of elders, [being] young.

**8:11** I shall be found sharp in judgment, and I shall be a wonder before rulers.

**8:12** When I am-silent, they shall await [me], and when I speak, they shall give-heed, and when I speak-at-greater-length, they shall put hand upon mouth.

**8:13** Because-of her I shall have immortality, and I shall leave behind an eternal memorial to those coming after me.

**8:14** I shall govern peoples, and nations shall be subjected to me.

**8:15** Formidable rulers shall fear [me] hearing-of-me; among a multitude I shall appear good and in war courageous.

**8:16** When I enter my house, I shall rest beside her; for the companionship with her has no bitterness, and living-together with her has no grief, but gladness and joy.

**8:17** Considering these-things in myself and reasoning in my heart, that immortality is in kinship with Wisdom,

**8:18** and in her friendship [is] good pleasure, and in the labors of her hands [is] inexhaustible wealth, and in the practice-of-companionship with her [is] understanding, and great fame in sharing-speech with her, I went about seeking how to-take her to myself.

**8:19** A good-natured child I was, and a good soul fell to my lot;

**8:20** rather, being good I came into an undefiled body.

**8:21** But knowing that I would not otherwise be self-controlled, unless God gives [it] — and this itself was of insight, to know whose the gift is — I approached the Lord and petitioned him, and I said from my-whole heart:
